supporting_observations.claim: The alerted failures are for svc-claimsync from FILE-HD-01, with the host reporting WorkstationName=FILE-HD-01 and source address 10.30.20.20; the failures repeat at roughly one-minute intervals from 13:31 through 13:46.

The failures report bad-password status (SubStatus=0xc000006a); the provided calendar says svc-claimsync was scheduled for password rotation at 13:30 UTC, and the inventory says its FILE-HD-01 job re-authenticates every minute. The timing, source, and cadence are consistent with the job continuing to use a stale password after rotation, rather than establishing malicious activity.

Domain-controller records also show failures for svc-claimsync around the same times, including bad-password status in the 4776 records; this is consistent with the FILE-HD-01 authentication failures.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records for the repeated failures end at 13:46:09 UTC (T002-00034, T002-00035); they do not show whether or when the job was updated or whether authentication later succeeded.
The records show failed authentication attempts and their source/workstation, but do not directly identify the ClaimSync job configuration or prove the password rotation caused these failures.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish that an attacker obtained or used the svc-claimsync password.
The evidence does not establish whether the ClaimSync job was manually updated after the rotation or whether the failures continued through the full review window.
unrelated_findings: Review separately: a 4648 record shows SYSTEM on WS-LPARK-01 using explicit svc-claimsync credentials for PROXY-HD-01 via C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe. This is not the FILE-HD-01 failure sequence and does not decide this alert; investigate the purpose and authorization of this credential use in a separate ticket (T002-00019).
